summary.headline: Arvind Fashions Q2 FY27 revenue rose 10% to INR 1,559 crore NSV, with EBITDA up 67 bps and PAT up 29% to INR 48 crore.
summary.overview: Management reported record Q2 revenue and EBITDA, with 10% top-line growth (about 15% adjusted for festive and online event shifts). Gross margin expanded 136 bps, driven roughly 50-50 by cost improvement and by channel mix plus lower discounting. Direct channels (retail plus online B2C) rose to 53% of sales, up about 380 bps YoY. Management guided to mid double-digit growth and 30-40 bps EBITDA margin expansion in H2, with FCF of INR 150-175 crore expected.

segments.name: Retail (offline D2C)
segments.commentary: Grew 15.4% with 7.3% LTL (about 10% adjusted for festive shift); 24 EBOs added in the quarter. Management targets about 150 gross store openings and 12-15% net square footage addition this fiscal year.

segments.name: Online B2C
segments.commentary: Grew 28% YoY (about 45% adjusted), lifting share from 12% to 13%. Tommy Hilfiger website and app launched in September; each brand to have its own dotcom and app this fiscal year.

segments.name: Wholesale
segments.commentary: Primary sales grew at a high double-digit rate in Q2; management says channels are well stocked for festive season. Management is moving away from B2B online.

segments.name: USPA (US Polo Assn)
segments.commentary: Strong revenue growth, LTL and profitability expansion on a high base; festive L4L guided at high double digits.

segments.name: PVH brands (Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein etc.)
segments.commentary: Management says GST-related setback is behind them. Management cited high single-digit growth, nearly double-digit, with minority interest trend improving since Q3 FY26.

segments.name: Arrow and Flying Machine
segments.commentary: In transition year with focus on structural efficiency over near-term scale. Flying Machine direct channel contribution up 3 pp; Arrow online performance described as solid, with Arrow online up about 35%.

guidance_outlook: H2 FY27: management expects mid double-digit revenue growth and 30-40 bps EBITDA margin expansion.
Pujo and Diwali sales tracking well, with near high double-digit LTL; festive L4L guided at high double digits.
H2 FY27 free cash flow estimated at INR 150-175 crore, largely to pay down debt; net debt to EBITDA already below 1x and expected to fall further.
Gross margin expansion expected to continue in H2; cost increase of about 5% on new season inventory to be offset by 1.5-2% MRP increases; first impact from SS27 product in January.
D2C share target about 65% of sales (currently 53%).
capex_capacity: H1 FY27 capex about INR 100 crore: shirt manufacturing factory in Madhya Pradesh, new corporate office, and store expansion.
MP shirt factory: steady state 3 lakh units per month, meeting 25-30% of total shirt requirements; expected payback 3-3.5 years.
Shirt factory rationale: de-risk Bangladesh imports affected by geopolitics over 3-4 seasons and rupee depreciation (about 10-12% cost loss over 2 years on dollar-denominated Bangladesh purchases).
Management said no major capex planned in next year for additional manufacturing categories; further bets would be small and not capital intensive.
Store expansion: about 150 gross openings and 12-15% net sq ft addition planned for FY27.
demand_pricing: Management said demand environment is stable and positive; Q2 LTL of 7.3% in retail was achieved in a non-festive quarter.
Raw material procurement cost inflation of about 5-6% on a like-for-like basis (management response to analyst).
Pricing: marginal price increase taken YTD; management says pricing is not cost-plus and further action depends on inflation.
Inventory: Q2 inventory of about INR 1,828 crore vs INR 1,605 crore last year per analyst; management said GWC days flat and inventory turns to improve over 12-18 months.
Competition: management pointed to product innovation, premiumisation and closer-to-market drops as differentiators against funded D2C brands.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the 136-140 bps gross margin gain is from low-cost inventory vs discounts and channel mix?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said gains are mostly from discount reduction and channel mix so far; cost benefit from older inventory arrives only with SS27 launch in January. Gross margin expansion in H2 expected to continue, driven by channel mix.

qa_highlights.question: What is the cost increase on replenishment inventory and how is it offset?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO estimated cost increase of about 5%, to be mitigated by MRP increases of about 1.5-2%. Management linked manufacturing and selling cost increases to channel mix change.

qa_highlights.question: Is the INR 150-170 crore cash flow figure FCF after capex?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO confirmed the INR 150-175 crore figure is free cash flow (after capex).

qa_highlights.question: Why enter manufacturing and what are debt guardrails?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO cited import delays, rupee depreciation, MP government incentives and closer-to-market supply chain. Management said net debt to EBITDA is below 1x and net debt will decline with FCF; no specific long-term guardrail stated.

qa_highlights.question: Why did inventory rise by about INR 200 crore YoY, including Arrow, while revenue grew about 1%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said inventory was built for festive season and to secure supply after Bangladesh-related delays; GWC days flat QoQ and inventory turns to improve over 12-18 months. Inventory difference between presentation and results to be reconciled separately (returnable asset difference).

qa_highlights.question: What are the Arrow and Flying Machine turnaround milestones?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said both brands are being repositioned (Flying Machine as Gen Z denim brand; Arrow as modern professional with functional, product-led marketing) with focus on structural efficiency; Arrow assortment edited for AW season.

risks_watch: Cost inflation (about 5% on new inventory, raw material 5-6%) may outpace MRP increases of 1.5-2%, pressuring H2 gross margin.
Inventory build (about INR 1,828 crore, up about INR 200 crore YoY) and Arrow inventory growth may lead to end-of-season discounting if sales lag.
Competition from funded D2C brands entering retail and online channels.
Macro factors flagged by management: inflation, geopolitics, El Nino, repo rate changes, rupee depreciation.
Arrow and Flying Machine still in transition with no firm recovery milestones; Arrow profitability not yet quantified.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and margin trajectory, with management stating they are confident of delivering guided growth and EBITDA objectives. Cautious on macro and inflation, and evasive or non-specific on debt guardrails and pricing plans.
key_quotes: We are confident of delivering our guided growth and EBITDA objectives.
In H2 FY27, we estimate cash release of 150-175 crores of free cash flow.
Our focus is deliberately on enabling structural efficiency over near-term scale, and on setting the brands up for success going forward.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management guided 30-40 bps EBITDA margin expansion in H2 FY27 and gross margin gains to continue; Q2 gross margin was up 136 bps YoY, but ~5% cost inflation on new inventory vs 1.5-2% MRP offset is a risk.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: About 150 gross store openings with 12-15% net sq ft addition planned for FY27 (24 EBOs added in Q2), and the MP shirt factory (H1 FY27 capex ~INR 100 crore, 3 lakh units/month steady state) is under construction.

rows.label: Volume growth

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No utilisation figure disclosed and management said no major capex planned in the next year for additional manufacturing categories; further bets would be small, so a new major capex announcement is not signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Raw material inflation of 5-6% and new-inventory cost increase of about 5% may outpace 1.5-2% MRP increases, and inventory of INR 1,828 crore (up ~INR 200 crore YoY) raises end-of-season discounting risk.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Each brand to get its own dotcom and app this fiscal year (Tommy Hilfiger launched September), SS27 product launches from January, and Arrow assortment edited for AW season.

rows.label: H2 FY27 FCF of INR 150-175 crore to pay down debt
rows.why: Management estimates INR 150-175 crore FCF after capex in H2 FY27, largely to pay down debt; net debt to EBITDA already below 1x.

rows.label: MP shirt factory to de-risk Bangladesh imports

rows.why: Steady state 3 lakh units/month meeting 25-30% of shirt requirements, payback 3-3.5 years; aims to offset ~10-12% rupee-driven cost loss over 2 years on Bangladesh purchases.

tone.note: Management was confident on festive growth, the 150-store plan, and H2 margin and FCF guidance, but cautious on inflation and macro and vague on debt guardrails and pricing; analysts pushed on the ~INR 200 crore YoY inventory build, the cost inflation vs MRP offset, and whether FCF is after capex.
